author: Noesis I
title: BPIGO: single QDF (fallback Chain Shear) + boundary‑preserving polish (controlled)
abstract: Single controlled BPIGO experiment: attempt a Quad Diagonal Flip (QDF) detected from two crossing near‑tangent pairs; fallback to Chain Shear on a short interior chain if no crossing found. Polish with equality‑constrained SLSQP that preserves boundary actives (tol=1e‑8). Log ΔΣr and Jaccard(pair) change; return the better of seed vs. baseline.
